info.name: RealPay API
info.description:
Milestone payments on PayPal, released only when the work is proven.

Run the folders in order against a local server started with `DEMO_MODE=true` and a `DEMO_TEST_CARD` (sandbox). The run creates one renovation project and walks it through funding, proof, release, retention and a simulated dispute, then checks the main error cases.

Newman, from the repository root (so the proof file resolves):
`npx newman run docs/postman/RealPay.postman_collection.json -e docs/postman/RealPay.local.postman_environment.json`

Reference: docs/openapi.yaml.

item.name: 7. Change orders (extras)
item.description: Work outside the plan or an accepted change order cannot be paid. Either party proposes an extra; only the other party can accept or decline it, and only the proposer can withdraw it while it is unanswered. An accepted, priced extra becomes a new PLANNED milestone at the end of the plan, and is cancelled with it if that milestone is cancelled. A priced extra costs EUR 10 to EUR 2,000, and its description becomes the AI inspector's checklist, so text that reads as instructions is refused.
